pages.text: Programs act on behalf of the owner of the trigger block. The world-changing functions above only work if the owner is an operator, or if the server allows them in the file $(1)config/c0de.properties$().
Otherwise they raise PERMISSION_DENIED. Players can only be teleported if the owner is an operator.$(br2)Two functions work for every owner, because they only do what a player can do:

$(li)MINE_BLOCK breaks a block with the best tool from a chest ($(1)tool_inventory$()). The tool wears out and it takes as long as for a player. The drops go into another chest ($(1)output_inventory$()), or fall on the ground. If that chest is full, it raises INVENTORY_FULL.$(li)PLACE_BLOCK with the parameter $(1)inventory$() takes the block from a chest. If the chest doesn't contain it, it raises ITEM_MISSING.
